title: Texans safety Jalen Pitre signs with Guardian Caps as company's first 'signature athlete'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Texans safety Jalen Pitre signs with Guardian Caps as company's first 'signature athlete'
sources.description: Guardian caps, designed to help lessen the effects of head injuries, are mandated in NFL practices for most positions, though Pitre is one of a handful of players that wears the caps in-game.
